detail: Full summary: src/retrieval/store-identity.ts readStoreIdentity requires store.json `repo_id` but ensureStoreDescriptor (identity init, adapter test fixtures, the trial seeder) writes only `repo_ids`; only migrate (v3-forward finalize) writes both. On an identity-init v3 store the ContextAssembler gates with a path-derived synthetic repo (format 2, derived: true, source 'derived-from-path'), not the minted repo_ids[0] that runtime.ts/repoIdFor stamps on every v3 event. 2.x-path retrieval still works (envelope and rows share the synthetic id by construction) but the RetrievalAnnex misreports repo_identity_source/format, and any future 2.x-row vs v3 scope.repo comparison will mismatch. v3-forward resolveIdentity/migrateStatus also read only repo_id, so `migrate` run AFTER `identity init` would mint a new seeded store_id/repo_id and overwrite store.json, orphaning ids already cited by events and memberships. Fix candidate: readStoreIdentity falls back to repo_ids[0] (+ unit test); deliberately not done under D51.
